description.value: A Whistler institution since 2003, the Southside Diner serves hearty homestyle breakfasts and burgers in an old-school diner atmosphere at Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood. The building also houses Southside Suds, described as Creekside's only coin-operated laundromat, making it an unusually practical stop for multi-day touring cyclists who need to refresh their kit. The diner has cultivated a loyal following among both locals and visitors over more than two decades.

address.value: 2102 Lake Placid Rd, Creekside, Whistler, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at southsidediner.ca is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name and website URL; address (2102 Lake Placid Rd, Creekside, Whistler, BC) and phone (604-966-0668) are sourced from the website since OSM lacks both fields. No website content explicitly mentions bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, so those remain null; takeout is confirmed by the front page listing 'take out DINE IN', and vegan/vegetarian options are directly evidenced by labeled menu items including a 'VEGAN VEGGIE WRAP' and 'BUDDHA BOWL'.
